item.title: Significant cracks and worsening subsidence, 10th September
item.description:
The road continues to subside and crack along its full length from Hyde Lane to the level crossing. The stretch particularly between Hyde Lane and Longacre Farm has subsidence that causes cars to bottom out and tip excessively. This has caused large cracks to open up, now wide enough to swallow a bike tire with ease. The road is - and has been for a long time - in a dangerous condition. How bad does it need to be before something more substantial is done (ie resurfacing)?!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Brockhampton Lane, Bishop's Cleeve, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
